// flow: if/else chains, the three for forms, range, break, continue,
// block scoping and defer.
x := 1;
if x > 5 {
	x = 2
} else if x > 0 {
	x = 4
} else {
	x = 3
}
assert.Equal(tb, 4, x);

sum := 0;
for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
	sum = sum + i
}
assert.Equal(tb, 10, sum);

n := 0;
for n < 3 {
	n++
}
assert.Equal(tb, 3, n);

hits := 0;
for {
	hits++
	if hits == 4 {
		break
	}
}
assert.Equal(tb, 4, hits);

odd := 0;
for i := 0; i < 10; i++ {
	if i%2 == 0 {
		continue
	}
	odd = odd + i
}
assert.Equal(tb, 25, odd);

parts := strings.Fields("a b c");
joined := "";
for _, w := range parts {
	joined = joined + w
}
assert.Equal(tb, "abc", joined);

outer := 7;
if outer > 0 {
	outer := 1
	outer++
}
assert.Equal(tb, 7, outer);

defer assert.True(tb, true, "deferred assertion ran");
